outcome: Maternal and placental iron availability and storage
cohort: The study included women with normotensive pregnancies and those with early- or late-onset preeclampsia.
finding: Preeclamptic pregnancies exhibit altered maternal erythroferrone and hepcidin levels, as well as reduced placental erythroferrone and transferrin receptor 1, indicating deregulated maternal iron bioavailability compared to normotensive pregnancies.
